standard_prerequisites.name: Sheafification computes cohomology
standard_prerequisites.use: H^m(R lim K_n) is the sheafification of U |-> H^m(U, R lim K_n).

standard_prerequisites.name: Milnor sequence
standard_prerequisites.use: The short exact sequence for H^m(U, R lim K_n).

core_obligations: Choose U  in  U_x and gamma  in  H^m(U, R lim K_n) mapping to the stalk class gamma; after shrinking U assume the image gamma_{n(x)}  in  H^m(U, K_{n(x)}) is zero, using that cohomology is the sheafification of the presheaf of cohomology over U (proof lines 9598-9609).

Conclude gamma = 0 from the short exact sequence 0 -> R^1 lim H^{m-1}(U,K_n) -> H^m(U, R lim K_n) -> lim H^m(U,K_n) -> 0: the left term vanishes by assumption (1) and the right term maps injectively to H^m(U,K_{n(x)}) by assumption (2); hence gamma = 0 (proof lines 9610-9621).
proof_roadmap: Represent the stalk class on a neighbourhood and shrink.
Kill it with the Milnor sequence under assumptions (1) and (2).
difficulty_reason: The proof is a stalk chase: represent the stalk class on a neighbourhood U, shrink so its image in H^m(K_{n(x)}) vanishes, then conclude via the Milnor sequence whose two ends are controlled by assumptions (1) and (2).
